title: What is Clustering in Machine Learning? Introduction to Unsupervised Learning

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this new section.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到這個新單元。

cues.en: Super excited to have you on board because today we're talking about clustering, which is going to be our very first encounter with unsupervised machine learning.
cues.zh: 很高興你一起參與，因為今天要談分群，這將是我們第一次接觸非監督式機器學習。

cues.en: So, let's have a look.
cues.zh: 我們來看看。

cues.en: Clustering can be defined as grouping unlabeled data.
cues.zh: 分群可以定義為把沒有標籤的資料分組。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思呢？

cues.en: Well, so far in this course, we've been working with supervised learning types of algorithms, which include regression and classification.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，這門課使用的都是監督式學習演算法，包括迴歸和分類。

cues.en: And the way supervised learning algorithms work is that you already have some training data and an answer and answers in that training data that you supply to the model.
cues.zh: 監督式學習演算法的運作方式，是先準備訓練資料，以及資料中的答案，再一起提供給模型。

cues.en: So, for example, in the case of classification, you have input data, which could be images of apples and you have annotations explaining these are apples or labels for these apples.
cues.zh: 例如分類問題，輸入資料可以是蘋果的圖片，而且附有說明「這些是蘋果」的註記，也就是這些蘋果的標籤。

cues.en: And then you supply that to the model.
cues.zh: 然後把這些資料提供給模型。

cues.en: You ask the model to learn from these, from this data with answers.
cues.zh: 請模型從這些附有答案的資料中學習。

cues.en: And then you can supply a new image and ask, "What is this?"
cues.zh: 接著就可以提供一張新圖片，問它：「這是什麼？」

cues.en: And it will provide the answer saying that this is an apple.
cues.zh: 它就會回答這是蘋果。

cues.en: Now, unsupervised learning is different.
cues.zh: 非監督式學習就不同了。

cues.en: Here, we don't have answers, and the model has to think for itself.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有答案，模型必須自己思考。

cues.en: So, for example, we might have input data for these images without any labels, supply them to the model and ask them to group these fruits
cues.zh: 例如，我們可能有這些沒有任何標籤的圖片作為輸入資料，把圖片提供給模型，請它把這些水果

cues.en: into different categories, even though we don't know the category, we don't supply the categories.
cues.zh: 分成不同類別；即使我們不知道有哪些類別，也不會提供類別給它。

cues.en: So the machine has no understanding which is an apple, which is a banana, and so on.
cues.zh: 因此，機器並不知道哪個是蘋果、哪個是香蕉等等。

cues.en: It can just see that there are certain similarities in the data, certain differences in the data, and from that it can make conclusions and create its own groups.
cues.zh: 它只看得出資料中某些相似之處與差異，再根據這些資訊得出結論，建立自己的群組。

cues.en: And this is all the while it doesn't understand what it is looking at, doesn't understand the term apple or banana.
cues.zh: 在這個過程中，它並不了解自己看到的是什麼，也不懂蘋果或香蕉這些詞。

cues.en: So, that is the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning.
cues.zh: 這就是監督式與非監督式學習的差別。

cues.en: In a nutshell, in supervised learning, you give the model an opportunity to train where it has the answers.
cues.zh: 簡單來說，監督式學習讓模型在有答案的情況下進行訓練。

cues.en: In unsupervised learning, you don't have the answers to supply to the model.
cues.zh: 非監督式學習則沒有答案可以提供給模型。

cues.en: So, let's look at an example of this in a business sense.
cues.zh: 接著從商業角度看一個例子。

cues.en: Here we have an X Y-axis with annual income of your customers, of a store, for example and the spending score.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個 X、Y 座標圖，顯示顧客的年收入，例如某家商店的顧客，以及他們的消費分數。

cues.en: So how often do they spend? How much do they buy?
cues.zh: 也就是他們多久消費一次、購買多少東西。

cues.en: All their spending patterns.
cues.zh: 包括他們所有的消費模式。

cues.en: All of this is combined already into a spending score.
cues.zh: 這些資訊都已經整合成一個消費分數。

cues.en: So when you plot your customers, it might look like this and you don't have any preexisting categories.
cues.zh: 把顧客畫在圖上，可能就會像這樣，而且你事先沒有任何類別。

cues.en: You don't have any preexisting classes or groups of customers to group them into.
cues.zh: 沒有既有的顧客類別或群組，可以直接把他們歸進去。

cues.en: You want to create those groups.
cues.zh: 你想建立這些群組。

cues.en: So that's where you would apply clustering.
cues.zh: 這時就可以運用分群。

cues.en: And by applying clustering, it would show you that these are probably likely groups of customers.
cues.zh: 透過分群，模型會顯示這些可能的顧客群組。

cues.en: And then you could go into this further, dig deeper and understand why these groups might be emerging, what this might be in a business sense, in a spending sense, in a customer sense,
cues.zh: 接著你可以進一步深入研究，了解這些群組為什麼會形成，以及從商業、消費與顧客角度來看，它們代表什麼。

cues.en: understand how to best service these customers, to what kind of promotions to send to one group versus the other, what kind of reminders or what kind of offers to create
cues.zh: 了解如何最有效地服務這些顧客、不同群組分別該收到什麼促銷活動，以及該為他們設計什麼提醒或優惠，

cues.en: for these different customers and how to best use this information in your business.
cues.zh: 並了解如何在業務中善用這些資訊。

cues.en: So, that's clustering.
cues.zh: 這就是分群。

cues.en: As you can see, it's very different to what we've discussed before.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，它和我們之前討論的內容很不一樣。

cues.en: It's a very interesting and exciting area of machine learning where the model gets to think for itself and come up with suggestions and interesting ideas.
cues.zh: 這是機器學習中非常有趣、令人期待的領域，模型能自行思考，提出建議和有意思的想法。

cues.en: I look forward to exploring clustering further with you in this section.
cues.zh: 期待在這個單元和你一起進一步探索分群。

cues.en: And until next time, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 我們下次見，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
